js: window.__until = async (f, ms) => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (;;) { try { if (f()) return true; } catch {} if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) return false; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }

name: row-hover-ripple
js: (function(){const s=window.__books.state('book.pride-and-prejudice');const f=window.__books.state('book.anna-karenina');return s.motion.lift>0.004 && f.motion.lift>0.004 && document.getElementById('label').textContent.indexOf('click to see them all')>=0;})()

name: shelf-active
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.active && s.spread > 0.99; }, 15000)

name: jar-note-beside-title
js: (function(){const b=document.querySelector('#panel h1 button.jar-link');return !!b && b.textContent==='notes on focus' && document.getElementById('panel-title').textContent.indexOf('Leave a slip')===0;})()

name: jar-notes-open
js: window.__until(() => { const s = document.querySelector('#panel .jar-principles'); return s && s.classList.contains('open') && s.querySelectorAll('p').length === 4 && /This slip is the door\.$/.test(s.textContent.trim()); }, 8000)

name: puppet-intro-order
js: (function(){const t=document.querySelector('#panel .content').textContent;const h=document.getElementById('panel-title').textContent;return h==='insanely great product' && t.indexOf('A puppet, an iphone')<t.indexOf('My goal is') && t.indexOf('My goal is')<t.indexOf('Click the puppet') && t.indexOf('Click the puppet')<t.indexOf('Life needs to be more') && t.indexOf('reminder of the pursuit')<0 && t.indexOf('Why it matters')<0;})()

name: puppet-item-text
js: window.__until(() => { const h=document.querySelector('#panel .pin-item h2'); const t=document.querySelector('#panel .pin-item')?.textContent||''; return h && h.textContent==='Animated characters in real life' && /Disney’s attention to detail/.test(t) && !/Why it matters/.test(t); }, 6000)

name: guitar-line
js: document.querySelector('#panel .content').textContent.trim()==='I recently picked up guitar! might upload some musics here soon'

name: realm-text
js: /Realm is a small team of artists with high standards/.test(document.querySelector('#panel .content').textContent)
